title: Charging a Restocking Fee against a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Return
content:
Where a restocking fee falls due on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking authorisation, it is charged against that return. The result the charge governs is the amount of the fee. Charging it adds a restocking fee entry to the return's history, recorded as the restocking fee component of the settlement and carrying the condition the item was graded at, and raises the restocking fee still outstanding on the return by the amount charged. The customer can see the fee and the grade it rests on against their return from that moment, and the return's own outstanding figure moves with it. The return keeps the state it stands in.

## Charging the fee

The fee is charged with `charge_restocking_fee_677c7b7a`, which is a tool the agent unlocks and then calls.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `return_authorization_id` | the reference number of the return authorisation the fee is charged against, read from the return authorisation record retrieved for the customer before the call |
| `restocking_fee_amount` | the fee being charged, in USD to 2 decimal places, always positive, given to the cent with at most two decimal places and never carrying a currency symbol or thousands separator |
| `inspection_grade` | the condition the item was graded at, which the fee is recorded against, exactly one of the seven values below |

`inspection_grade` takes exactly one of: `as_new_sealed`, the packaging was never opened; `open_box_complete`, the item was opened and everything that belongs in the box came back; `open_box_incomplete`, the item was opened and something is missing from the box; `damaged_by_customer`, the item carries damage the customer caused; `defective_on_arrival`, the item failed or was damaged when it reached the customer; `not_as_described`, the item is not what the order said it was; `beyond_economic_repair`, the item cannot be put right for less than it is worth.

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the restocking fee entry reference that was created, the amount charged in USD to two decimal places, the grade it was recorded against and the restocking fee now outstanding on the return. The sentence appearing at all means the entry was written and the outstanding figure has moved.
